$comment: High or critical npm advisories that CI allows for now. Each needs a reason, a tracking issue, and a date to look at it again. scripts/audit.ts fails on anything not listed here, on an entry past its review_by date, and on an entry npm audit no longer reports.

advisories.reason: No fixed release exists (all versions <=3.0.3 are affected, and 3.0.3 is the latest). Reached only through the dev-only CSS linter (stylelint, globby, fast-glob, micromatch, braces), which reads only this repo's own src/**/*.css glob. Nothing from it ships to the browser or the Worker.
